title.en: Assignment of Functions to National Environment Agency

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
National Environment Agency Act
(Chapter 195)
Assignment of Functions to National Environment Agency
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 11(2) of the National Environment Agency Act, the Minister for the Environment hereby assigns to the National Environment Agency the following functions:
(a)to construct, develop and manage hawker centres in its own right or as an agent of —
(i)the Government; or
(ii)any body corporate established by written law; and
(b)to construct, develop and manage crematoria, columbaria and burial facilities in its own right or as an agent of the Government.
